purpose: Specific official FSSAI/FoSCoS regulatory classification and named identity routes for standardized products and special categories. This file contains category/identity links, not complete compliance determinations.
prohibitions: Never equate FCS codes or recipe numbers with operative FSSR standard clauses.
Never pass full compliance based solely on this category mapping.
For FPC 18, do not automatically apply this route to a food already standardized in FPC 01-14.
Do not assume FSSAI 2025 Ayurveda Aahara recipe list is exhaustive after June 2026 Part 2.
Never treat FCS category mapping as a standalone FSSR product standard.
Never treat Chapter 3 additive identity/purity as permission for use in a finished food.
For dried edible seeds, observe the 15 March 2024 FSSAI interim licensing order until a newer official standard is independently verified.
